sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

At its core, Rolly Ball is a simple yet challenging game that requires players to navigate a ball through increasingly complex mazes. The gameplay is divided into levels, each with its own unique obstacles and challenges. Another key feature of Rolly Ball is its level design, which gets progressively harder as you progress through the levels. The mazes become increasingly complex, with more obstacles and challenges to overcome. This keeps the gameplay fresh and exciting, even after you've completed all the levels.
